articles.title: CoreWeave Eyes $4.5B Loan, but Bankruptcy Odds Rise to 21% on Prediction Markets
articles.summary: CoreWeave, an AI infrastructure provider, is seeking a $4.5B loan while bankruptcy odds on prediction markets have climbed to 21%, signaling serious doubts about the company's ability to service that debt. If CoreWeave defaults, it could crater the value of corporate credit contracts tied to the company and validate the thesis that AI infrastructure plays are overleveraged and fragile.

articles.title: CBOE Bets on Prediction Markets to Broaden Its Retail Footprint
articles.summary: CBOE is making a push into retail prediction markets, betting that Main Street wants easier access to the same derivatives infrastructure that powers institutional trading. If they pull it off, they'll legitimize prediction markets at scale and potentially unlock billions in retail volume that currently flows to unregulated offshore platforms.

articles.title: Kalshi Trump Mention Markets Were Surprisingly Accurate
articles.summary: Kalshi's markets on Trump mentions during speeches nailed their predictions with uncanny accuracy. If niche behavioral metrics can be priced that well, it validates the broader premise that prediction markets beat traditional forecasters on damn near anything.

articles.title: Robinhood Expands Prediction Markets: A New Revenue Stream Ahead?
articles.summary: Robinhood is launching prediction markets, adding yet another betting product to its retail trading arsenal. If they can convert their 23M users even partially, this becomes the most consequential distribution play for prediction markets since the category's inception.

articles.title: Polymarket Odds Today: Taipei Mayor, Sweden PM, Super Bowl
articles.summary: Three separate political races and a major sports event are drawing serious action on Polymarket today, with odds suggesting some genuine uncertainty in Taiwan's mayoral race and Sweden's PM situation alongside the Super Bowl's predictable tightening. Prediction market volume on these events tells us where smart money sees real edges, which usually means the consensus is either way off or rapidly repricing.

articles.title: Kalshi pushes 'microinsurance' for small businesses as sports contracts hit roadblocks
articles.summary: Kalshi is pivoting toward microinsurance products for small businesses after hitting regulatory walls with its sports betting contracts. It's a classic workaround play that could reshape how prediction markets navigate compliance, but it also signals the category's growth ceiling under current rules.

articles.title: It’s up to Congress to clean up the country’s prediction-market mess
articles.summary: Congress is finally acknowledging that prediction markets need actual rules instead of the legal gray zone they've been operating in. If they actually legislate this space, we're either getting a legitimacy boost that transforms these markets into real price-discovery engines, or we're getting regulations so restrictive that half the interesting bets disappear.

articles.title: Shane Steichen Trending Up in Coaches Fired Market on Kalshi
articles.summary: Shane Steichen is gaining odds as a potential NFL coach to be fired this season, suggesting prediction market traders think the Colts' head coach's job security is shakier than the public realizes. The trending odds matter because Steichen just took over in Indianapolis and would represent an unusually quick coaching turnover, making this a valuable contrarian bet if you think the Colts' front office is more trigger-happy than the market currently prices.

articles.title: In defense of prediction markets | Sauer
articles.summary: Sauer's making the case that prediction markets actually work and deserve more respect than they're currently getting from regulators and skeptics. If this gains traction, it could be the intellectual ammunition needed to push for loosening the legal restrictions that keep US prediction markets hobbled compared to their international cousins.

articles.title: How Louisiana became a battleground in the national fight over prediction markets
articles.summary: Louisiana's regulatory crackdown on prediction markets is forcing the industry to fight on unfamiliar legal ground, turning a single state into a test case for broader restrictions. If Louisiana succeeds in boxing out the platforms, it'll give other states a roadmap to follow, and suddenly your favorite markets could vanish overnight.

articles.title: 'Survival is at stake': Inside prediction markets' race to curb inside trading - ABC News
articles.source: Breaking News, Latest News and Videos
articles.summary: Regulators and market operators are cracking down on insider trading in prediction markets, where people with non-public information can easily profit before major announcements. If they don't fix this, the whole industry tanks, because no one's betting real money on markets they know are rigged.

articles.title: Use Kalshi and Polymarket to Trade on Chiefs vs Bills
articles.summary: The NFL playoff matchup between Kansas City and Buffalo is now tradeable on two major prediction markets, giving bettors a regulated option on Kalshi and an offshore alternative on Polymarket. Volume on these platforms tends to spike during high-profile sports events, making this the kind of liquidity test that determines whether U.S. regulated prediction markets can actually compete with their shadier cousins.
